title: Monotonicity of the threshold log ratio
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, taking values in $\{-1,1\}$. Let $p_c\in(0,1/2)$ and suppose the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$. Then the function $p\mapsto-\log(1-q_f(p))-\tfrac12\log p$, where $q_f$ is that biased minus-probability polynomial, is monotone on $[p_c,1/2]$; that is, it is nondecreasing there.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ is $1/2$
